thread:
Wanda: quick PR question — in the Security & Compliance doc i wrote 'we maintain SOC2 controls' but legal flagged that as ambiguous. thinking: change to 'Redwood maintains controls aligned with SOC 2 criteria and industry best practices' and add a tiny audit-log retention + redaction example. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/1301

Omar: yep, +1. engineers want a concrete example: TTL header, a pseudonymization step, and a before/after sample of an audit event. keep it short.

Wanda: pasted draft snippets in the PR comment, copying here for visibility. please shout if wording or examples are risky.

Wanda: BEFORE (raw event):
```json
{
  "event_id": "evt_2026_0001",
  "user": { "id": "user_12345", "email": "alice@example.com" },
  "action": "api.key.create",
  "timestamp": "2026-02-11T09:12:00Z"
}
```

Wanda: AFTER (pseudonymized for retention/export):
```json
{
  "event_id": "evt_2026_0001",
  "user": { "id": "usr_pseudonym_9a8b", "email": "redacted" },
  "action": "api.key.create",
  "timestamp": "2026-02-11T09:12:00Z",
  "pseudonymized": true
}
```

Wanda: CURL example showing TTL header (ops-friendly):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/audit/events \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "X-Redwood-Audit-Retention: 90d" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"event_type":"api.key.create","details":"..."}'
```

Wanda: Python SDK example (pseudo):
```python
from redwood import AuditClient
client = AuditClient(api_key="${REDWOOD_KEY}")
client.log_event({"event_type": "api.key.create"}, retention_ttl="90d", pseudonymize=["user.email"]) 
```

Omar: nit: remove comments inside JSON, show explicit before/after like you did — good. also recommend adding a one-line callout for customers needing formal evidence.

Sara: legal note: do NOT state "we are SOC2 certified" unless linking to the attestation. preferred phrasing: "Redwood maintains controls aligned with SOC 2 criteria and undergoes independent third-party assessment." also add: "For audit evidence and export procedures, contact support@redwood.com."

Wanda: updated PR text to use sara's phrasing and inserted the contact line.

Kevin: please include defaults: hosted API default retention 90 days, Dedicated/Private configurable by tenant and may be subject to contract. keep it brief.

Wanda: added defaults to PR and noted that Dedicated/Private can override. Also removed any inline JSON comments.

docs-ci-bot: PR check — docs linter failed: code-block-language should be one of (json, bash, python). Found mixed or unlabeled blocks. See CI: https://ci.redwood.example/1301/logs

Wanda: fixing block labels now and pushing. will merge after CI + legal ack. thanks everyone :rocket:
